    24	**An allow skips all of this (#845).** A route the user has allowed for a role (or listed exactly in that role's `preferred_seed`) is `available` at once: it needs no probe and no discovery trial, and `dispatchable: false` in the catalog or the user catalog overlay no longer hides it. If it then fails at runtime, Office logs `route.failed`, demotes it for a TTL and falls back to the next eligible route. Hydrogen is an exception: an exact user allow skips the enabled flag, S/M, risk, and canary reservation limits, but it needs the exact size and effort and a fresh exact probe pass. Hydrogen serves two roles only. It is an executor, and since H3 (#1168) it is also a voting `code_reviewer`, but only as the exact `agy/gemini-4-hydrogen@high` route, the effort that ran the planted-bug set. That route needs the user's exact allow (`office route allow agy/gemini-4-hydrogen@high --role code_reviewer`); a `preferred_seed` entry alone does not admit it. It is never a planner, worker, plan reviewer or visual reviewer. Discovery below is for routes the user has not allowed.
